name: forge-standard-review
description: Quota-free iterative code review with continuous loop — MCP stdio server wrapping review.sh

tools.name: forge_review
tools.description: Run forge-standard-review review loop (wraps scripts/review.sh). Supports staged, range, and file modes with ranked report.

mode.description: Review mode: staged (git diff --cached), range (commit range), file (single file), auto (staged else BASE...HEAD)

range.description: Git range for range mode, e.g. HEAD~1..HEAD or main...feature

file.description: File path for file mode, e.g. path/to/file.ts

preview.description: If true, only preview the diff without running the loop

workdir.description: Working directory to run review in (defaults to repo root / current cwd)
